aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP/AD) in StoneOS.
aaa_enabled.notes: Configure remote AAA servers under global configuration mode: aaa-server <name> type <type>.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable HTTP management and restrict SSH access.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Use the configuration access commands to restrict management methods.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Modify session timeout under global configuration in minutes (range 0-60).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: StoneOS local administrative passwords are automatically hashed in the system.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Modify SNMP community settings under global configuration: snmp-server community <name>.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH configuration settings are managed via the ssh command suite under global configuration mode.

logging_enabled.notes: Configure a syslog host using the logging syslog command.

management_acl.summary: Restrict Web Management Console and SSH access to trusted IP hosts.
management_acl.notes: Restrict access by defining management zones or ACL interface permissions.

login_banner.notes: Configure login warning banner in global configuration.

password_min_length.notes: Configure password complexity rules under global configuration settings.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure SNMP communities are restricted to read-only.
